metadata.description: Kicksaw delivery kit plugins. Add this repo as a marketplace in Claude (Customize, Plugins, Add marketplace) and install Kicksaw Project Start Motion from it; turn on Sync automatically so weekly releases reach you.

plugins.name: start-motion
plugins.description: Kicksaw Project Start Motion: the seven delivery stages as skills, run as /start-motion:handoff, kickoff, discovery-plan, discovery-call, readout, design, user-stories and refinement, plus /start-motion:new-client to set a client up. Three review agents check requirements, stories and the design before they reach the SC or SA.
